Method of Attack: Infects Windows computers with IE9 or higher
Installs Maps Galaxy toolbar changing IE homepage to MyWay (hp.myway.com)
Contacts command-and-control server to download word list
Runs search queries on MyWay search engine
Clicks on first ten search results including promoted ads via Windows IHTMLDocument2 interface
Generates click-fraud revenue by clicking ads
Impacted Systems: Windows computers with Internet Explorer 9 or higher
Attack Vector: Adware bundles installing the trojan without user knowledge
